coverage_gaps: Clinical benefit from LRRK2 inhibition may remain unresolved if cutoff-date trials report target engagement or safety without definitive efficacy outcomes.
Physiological substrate ranking may remain tissue-, stimulus-, and assay-dependent, especially where endogenous human brain validation is sparse.
Penetrance and effect estimates may be underpowered or poorly generalizable for rare variants and underrepresented ancestries.
Negative and null findings may be less retrievable than positive mechanistic studies, creating publication-bias risk.
FDA materials may provide limited mechanistic detail for investigational programs that had no completed product review by the cutoff.
exclusion_criteria: Studies mentioning LRRK2 only as an untested member of a broad gene list or pathway enrichment result.
Untraceable narrative assertions, promotional materials, conference summaries without sufficient methods or results, and duplicate secondary summaries of the same evidence.
Substrate assignments supported only by overexpression, motif prediction, or a single unvalidated assay when presented as physiological proof.
Parkinson-related studies that do not separate LRRK2 findings from unrelated genes, interventions, or disease populations.
Clinical studies with no LRRK2 intervention, genotype analysis, pathway biomarker, or mechanistically relevant outcome.
Non-FDA regulatory or commercial documents returned through the FDA route unless they link to an attributable FDA record.
Model phenotypes presented as human disease facts without explicit labeling of species, cell type, genotype, dose, and model limitations.
inclusion_criteria: Publication or record date is on or before 2024-12-31.

Evidence directly addresses LRRK2 genetic association, variant pathogenicity or risk, enzymatic function, physiological substrate identity, downstream disease mechanism, target engagement, or therapeutic translation in Parkinson disease.
Human genetic claims require an identifiable cohort, pedigree, segregation analysis, association design, or curated clinical interpretation with traceable primary evidence.
Mechanistic claims require direct biochemical, structural, phosphoproteomic, cellular, animal, or human-biospecimen evidence with the tested LRRK2 variant and experimental context stated.
Substrate claims distinguish direct LRRK2 phosphorylation from pathway association and report the relevant phosphosite or orthogonal validation when available.
Clinical trial records must identify an LRRK2-directed intervention, genotype-defined population, target-engagement biomarker, safety outcome, or efficacy outcome relevant to Parkinson disease.
Regulatory records must be attributable to FDA and materially inform approval status, trial status, safety, or biomarker interpretation.
Reviews may organize terminology and citation trails, while historical discovery, quantitative effect, and mechanistic conclusions are checked against primary sources.

queries.purpose: Locate landmark human genetic discovery reports and authoritative historical reviews.
queries.query: (LRRK2 OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2" OR PARK8 OR dardarin) AND ("Parkinson disease" OR "Parkinson's disease") AND (discovery OR linkage OR mutation OR genetics)

queries.purpose: Retrieve evidence for major disease-associated variants, segregation, penetrance, and clinical phenotype.
queries.query: (LRRK2 OR PARK8) AND (G2019S OR R1441C OR R1441G OR R1441H OR Y1699C OR I2020T OR N1437H) AND (pathogenicity OR penetrance OR segregation OR phenotype)

queries.purpose: Capture population-specific risk alleles and ancestry-dependent effect estimates.
queries.query: LRRK2 AND (G2385R OR R1628P OR "risk variant") AND (Parkinson OR parkinsonism) AND (ancestry OR population OR association)

queries.purpose: Map variant-specific effects on kinase activity, GTPase cycling, conformation, and activation.
queries.query: LRRK2 AND (kinase OR GTPase OR ROC-COR OR autophosphorylation OR dimerization) AND (G2019S OR R1441 OR Y1699C OR I2020T OR mechanism)

queries.purpose: Identify proposed physiological substrates and the evidence establishing direct phosphorylation.
queries.query: LRRK2 AND (substrate OR phosphoproteomic OR phosphorylation) AND (Rab10 OR Rab8A OR Rab12 OR Rab29 OR Rab7L1 OR "Rab GTPase")

queries.purpose: Trace substrate phosphorylation into cellular pathways relevant to Parkinson disease.
queries.query: LRRK2 AND (Rab10 OR Rab8A OR Rab12) AND (lysosome OR autophagy OR mitophagy OR trafficking OR ciliogenesis OR immune)

queries.purpose: Confirm that proposed target engagement and substrate relationships occur in human biospecimens.
queries.query: LRRK2 AND "Parkinson disease" AND (human tissue OR brain OR neuron OR monocyte OR neutrophil) AND (phospho-Rab10 OR substrate OR kinase activity OR biomarker)

queries.purpose: Compare mechanistic phenotypes across animal, cellular, and patient-derived models.
queries.query: LRRK2 AND (knockout OR knock-in OR transgenic OR iPSC OR organoid) AND (G2019S OR R1441 OR Parkinson) AND (neurodegeneration OR dopamine neuron OR alpha-synuclein OR lysosome)

queries.purpose: Assess downstream convergence with broader Parkinson disease pathology.
queries.query: LRRK2 AND (alpha-synuclein OR SNCA OR tau OR mitochondria OR inflammation) AND (interaction OR pathway OR pathology) AND Parkinson

queries.purpose: Retrieve evidence that weakens universality, identifies exceptions, or supports alternative mechanisms.
queries.query: LRRK2 AND Parkinson AND (incomplete penetrance OR nonpenetrant OR heterogeneity OR conflicting OR limitation OR "loss of function" OR kinase-independent OR replication)

queries.purpose: Evaluate pharmacological evidence and limitations of inferring disease causality from inhibitor responses.
queries.query: LRRK2 AND (kinase inhibitor OR inhibition) AND (toxicity OR lung OR kidney OR safety OR compensatory OR off-target OR neuroprotection)

queries.purpose: Identify interventional and biomarker studies testing LRRK2 pathway engagement in mutation carriers and broader Parkinson populations.
queries.query: Condition: Parkinson Disease; Other terms: LRRK2 OR DNL201 OR DNL151 OR BIIB122

queries.purpose: Assess whether clinical studies demonstrate target engagement, clinical benefit, safety constraints, or only surrogate effects.
queries.query: Condition: Parkinson Disease; Intervention or other terms: LRRK2 inhibitor; Outcomes: phospho-Rab10 OR urinary BMP OR safety OR pulmonary

queries.purpose: Find FDA materials bearing on development status, safety concerns, biomarker qualification, or regulatory interpretation.
queries.query: LRRK2 Parkinson DNL201 DNL151 BIIB122 investigational new drug clinical hold safety

queries.purpose: Verify whether any LRRK2-directed therapy or mechanistic biomarker had FDA approval or formal regulatory endorsement by the cutoff.
queries.query: site:fda.gov LRRK2 Parkinson approval label review biomarker

queries.purpose: Capture late-cutoff studies that could revise variant interpretation, substrate hierarchy, or translational conclusions.
queries.query: (LRRK2 OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2") AND Parkinson AND (genetics OR Rab OR kinase OR substrate OR inhibitor) AND (2023:2024[dp])

question_frame: As of 2024-12-31, what human genetic, biochemical, cellular, animal-model, clinical, and regulatory evidence connects LRRK2 to Parkinson disease, from PARK8 discovery and variant-specific risk or penetrance through kinase and GTPase mechanisms, physiological Rab substrates, downstream pathology, and findings that constrain causal strength, ancestry generalizability, or therapeutic interpretation?
stop_rules: Stop the sentinel wave after landmark PARK8 linkage and cloning reports, at least one authoritative synthesis, and primary evidence for the major pathogenic and risk variants have been identified.

Stop variant expansion when each recurrent pathogenic variant and major ancestry-associated risk variant has at least one primary evidence source and additional searches yield no new variant class, ancestry group, or materially different penetrance estimate.

Stop mechanism retrieval when kinase, ROC-COR GTPase, activation-state, and variant-specific effects are covered by convergent structural or biochemical evidence plus at least one independent cellular validation.

Stop substrate retrieval when direct phosphorylation evidence, phosphosite validation, endogenous context, and functional consequences are mapped for the principal Rab substrates and two consecutive query refinements add no independently validated substrate family.
Stop translational retrieval after trial registry status, reported target-engagement and safety outcomes, and FDA approval or non-approval status are reconciled through the cutoff.

Stop challenge retrieval only after evidence is captured for incomplete penetrance, ancestry heterogeneity, variant-specific mechanisms, model dependence, physiological-context uncertainty, and pharmacological safety or surrogate-endpoint limitations.
Stop the update wave after all eligible 2023-2024 records are screened and backward or forward citation checks produce no new conclusion-changing evidence.

Declare saturation only when two consecutive retrieval iterations across all used routes add no new eligible primary study, variant category, substrate class, contradiction, or change to confidence grading.
